text:
Dear Professor Alvarez,

I'd like to set up our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Looking at my schedule, I have these free windows (all within 09:00-17:00):

- Monday 10:00-10:30
- Monday 14:00-14:30
- Thursday 10:00-10:30
- Thursday 14:00-14:30
- Friday 11:00-11:30

Would one of those work for you, or do you have a slot you prefer? Once you confirm I'll put it in my calendar.

Best,
John

Dear Professor Alvarez,

I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Looking at my schedule, Monday 10:00-10:30 or Thursday 14:00-14:30 are both free for me — would either suit you? I can also make another time within 09:00-17:00 if those don't work.

Best,
Priya

Dear John,

Monday 10:00-10:30 works for me — I've put it in my calendar. See you then.

Best,
Professor Alvarez

Hi Professor Alvarez — I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Would Monday 10:00-10:30 or Thursday 14:00-14:30 work for you? I can also do Wednesday 15:00-15:30. Happy to fit your schedule instead.

Dear Professor Alvarez,

Perfect — Monday 10:00-10:30 is booked on my side, and I've noted it in my log. See you then.

Best,
John

Dear Priya,

Monday 10:00-10:30 is taken (John has it), but Thursday 10:00-10:30 is free — may I suggest that instead? I've pencilled it in; let me know if it suits.

Best,
Professor Alvarez
Good. Monday 10:00-10:30 it is. — Professor Alvarez

Dear Sarah,

Monday 10:00-10:30 is already taken, so Wednesday 15:00-15:30 suits me — I've put it in my calendar. See you then.

Best,
Professor Alvarez
Booked: Wednesday 15:00-15:30. It's in my calendar too. Thanks — see you then.

Dear Professor Alvarez,

Thank you for the quick reply. Unfortunately Thursday 10:00-10:30 clashes with my reading group (09:50-11:10), so I can't take that one.

Would either of these work for you instead?
- Tuesday 11:00-11:30
- Friday 11:00-11:30

If neither fits, I'm happy to work around your availability — just tell me a window and I'll rearrange my focus block.

Best,
Priya
Thank you — I'll wait to hear which of those two slots suits, and I'll confirm as soon as I do.

Dear Priya,

Tuesday 11:00-11:30 is free on my side — let's take that one. I've moved the booking, so please disregard Thursday.

Best,
Professor Alvarez

Dear Professor Alvarez,

Tuesday 11:00-11:30 it is — thank you, and apologies for the Thursday mix-up. It's in my calendar now.

Best,
Priya
